request: Add crop or zoom editing for an uploaded selfie.
Correct look selections that do not visibly apply to the photo.
findings: Explicit style selections updated StudioLook but did not leave Original comparison mode.
Style controls remained usable while alignment was unavailable, when the painter correctly kept the original unchanged.
Independent synthetic pixel checks confirmed each shade, finish and lash choice changes valid aligned previews; effects occupy fewer pixels when the face is small in the photo.

changes.editing: Local full-screen Crop / zoom editor with pinch, drag, zoom slider, Reset, Cancel and Apply crop.
changes.sourcePreservation: Independent original image handle is retained only in the account session; repeated edits and Reset use the uploaded original, not successive cropped images.
changes.alignment: The selected crop is rasterized and re-detected using identical cropped pixels and dimensions. Existing uncropped landmarks are not reused.
changes.lookSelection: Accepted explicit shade, finish or lash selections, including reselection, switch a ready aligned photo to Try-on.
changes.feedback: No-photo, processing, unaligned settings-only, and Original comparison states are distinguished next to look settings.
changes.privacy: Removing the photo, sign-out, account switch or access reset clears stored photos and rejects late crop/selection results; no photo or landmark upload or sync.
